title: Towards evaluating and eliciting high-quality documentation for intelligent systems
reasoning: The paper mentions 'ethical and legal concerns' as a motivation for creating high-quality documentation. It also discusses a participant-suggested quality dimension called 'Faithfulness,' which is defined in the context of trustworthiness and the veracity of the information, not religious faith. The paper's core contribution is a set of dimensions for evaluating documentation quality, not a framework for evaluating or benchmarking ethics.
